CORE/PLAYLIST (new in WordPress 7.1) An audio player with a track list: one waveform player on top, the tracks listed below; a click on a track plays it. Audio files from the media library only (no video, no streams). For a single file use core/audio. REQUIRED STRUCTURE core/playlist > core/playlist-track (one per file, nothing else allowed inside). Every track needs "id" (the audio attachment id) and "src" (its file URL): the server skips a track without an id, and a playlist with no such track renders nothing. Take both from list-media; title, artist, album and length ("m:ss") are text you supply (the editor copies them from the file's metadata). image / imageAlt: an optional cover picture URL and its alt.
